newsitem.title: AUSTRIA: CA super board head offers resignation.
newsitem.headline: CA super board head offers resignation.

text.p: The head of Creditanstalt's non-executive supervisory board Walter Fremuth has offered his resignation following the bank's takeover by market leader Bank Austria, Creditanstalt said on Monday.
A bank spokesman told Reuters there were no plans "at the moment" by members of the bank's executive board, headed by Guido Schmidt-Chiari, to offer their resignations.
"I am offering my resignation to the new majority owner,". Fremuth told Austrian state radio. "They can either extend my term or accept it."
Fremuth added other members of the supervisory board and the executive board had to decide for themselves whether they would follow his lead.
Fremuth has headed the supervisory board since October 1993.
According to a government coalition agreement on the sale, Creditanstalt is to remain an independent bank for at least five years.
